text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, Trainer-kun! Big news, big 
news, this is huge~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan! This is bad, 
bad, so bad~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I was looking something up on my phone, 
and then this weird thing suddenly popped 
up!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Something about viruses and personal 
info... What's gonna happen to me now?

Looking at the smartphone screen, it was 
just an advertisement.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, there's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, thank goodness... I feel completely 
exhausted, though...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I know it'd be super handy once I master 
it, but it's still so difficult... 
*sigh*..."

Perhaps exhausted from worrying so much, 
Maruzensky was a bit wiped out after 
that...
